items.raw_desc: Festőállvány KREUL SOLO GOYA asztali, fa:The KREUL SOLO GOYA small easel is a small and finely crafted accessory for your creations. It is used for the decorative presentation of photos or small-format canvases. The easel is made of solid, oil-impregnated beech wood, which gives it a natural look and protects it. As it comes pre-assembled, you can start using it straight out of the box.     Key Features of the KREUL SOLO GOYA EaselDesigned for displaying photos and small canvasesMade of solid beech woodFSC® certified woodSurface treated with linseed oil impregnationSupplied assembled for immediate useSuitable for paintings with a maximum height of 30cmWeight 225gTotal height 40cmStable Design and Natural MaterialThe SOLO GOYA easel stands on three legs, providing stability on any flat surface, such as a table or chest of drawers. It is made of solid beech wood, the surface of which is impregnated with linseed oil. The linseed oil impregnation not only protects the wood but also enhances its natural grain.
